One-laptop demonstration evidence - 21 October 2026

What was run: two separate app.py processes (peer A and peer B) on ONE laptop,
each in its own console window, with keys injected on a schedule by a harness
(demo_peer.py, not part of the project). Interface: Wi-Fi 172.17.83.158.
Capture: tshark 4.6.9 on the Wi-Fi interface, capture filter 'igmp or udp port 5005'.
This shows this laptop transmitting; it does NOT show reception on another laptop.
